## BunkerBroadcastBunkerSettings

BunkerBroadcastBunkerSettings controls bunker selection and access-code
generation for each broadcast batch.

| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 3 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### BunkerBroadcastBunkerSettings.lockCodeLength

Key: `lockCodeLength`

Path: [`bunkerSettings`](#bunkerbroadcastfilebunkerbroadcastbunkersettings).`lockCodeLength`

LockCodeLength is the number of digits in generated access codes. The game
accepts values from 3 through 6.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |

### BunkerBroadcastBunkerSettings.lockCodeMode

Key: `lockCodeMode`

Path: [`bunkerSettings`](#bunkerbroadcastfilebunkerbroadcastbunkersettings).`lockCodeMode`

LockCodeMode selects the access-code generation mode. The game accepts only 0 or
1.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |

### BunkerBroadcastBunkerSettings.numberOfActive

Key: `numberOfActive`

Path: [`bunkerSettings`](#bunkerbroadcastfilebunkerbroadcastbunkersettings).`numberOfActive`

NumberOfActive is how many bunkers receive fresh codes in each batch. The game
accepts values from 1 through 30.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |

BunkerBroadcastProxy stores a world-space position where the game creates a

### BunkerBroadcastProxy.position

Key: `position`

Path: [`proxies`](#bunkerbroadcastfileproxies).`[]`.`position`
